description: Phase 3-Soak secondary metric. Drives the bulk-capable opt-in cross-product: 25% of clients have engine_set_allow_bulk_capable(1), 75% have (0). The verifier asserts no V1/V2 regression on either subset; the v2-superset's mode-budgets-v1 invariants must remain green across both halves. Mirrors the 2G locked default (OFF for the load tier) but exercises the cross-product. Day 1 every bulk-opt-in client flips the flag ON via engine_set_allow_bulk_capable. Day 7 the rig drives a bulk-mode session for the opt-in subset. Day 14 final ledger: bulk-capable subset has bulk-mode session in their ledger; non-opt-in subset never enters bulk mode. The v2-superset distribution-failure invariants continue to assert.
